captions.text: Next, tell Job Explorer what you're looking for.
Open Searches, and create your first search.
Give it a name, then add the job titles you want.
Describe the job you want in your own words.
The AI uses this to judge how well each job fits.
Add the skills you want the job to center on.
You can also list skills you have, but don't want as the main part of the job.
Onsite and hybrid jobs can be limited to cities near you, and remote jobs to the countries you can work in.
Below that are more filters, like a minimum salary, seniority, and how recent a posting must be.
The defaults are a good place to start.
When you're happy with it, click save search.
